replies.content: Picked this up from the design review. The lane order matches the Web board, so I only need to check the card spacing.
Captured the baselines on desktop and mobile. Two cards wrap to three lines in the narrow lane; the rest are pixel-identical.
收到，先把换行的两张卡片对齐，再处理深色主题。

Follow-up: the long title case still clamps at three lines in the modal, but the Show more toggle is missing when the description is exactly three lines long, which makes the layout jump by one line when the real description loads after the first paint. I will keep this thread updated with screenshots for every theme until the diff is below the tolerance and the elegant-dark pass has been reviewed by a second person on the team.

task.title: Capture the task board and detail baselines
task.description:
Capture the task board and the task detail modal in all three themes on desktop and mobile, then diff them against the production Web build.

Acceptance: every lane (todo, in progress, in review, done, closed) renders with the same card height, badge colour and spacing; the detail modal keeps the title clamp, the Show more toggle, the History timeline and the Status / Assignee / Created by row aligned to the same pixel grid as Web. Record any remaining difference with the case id, the screenshot path and the owner of the fix, and do not mark the task done before the elegant-dark pass has been reviewed by a second person.
